jobs.occupation: Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent | Customer Support Officer | East-European Languages
jobs.description:
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support.

 

What we expect from you : 

 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up. 

 
• Willingness to work in a shift system: early, late, day, night and weekend work. 
 
• Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside assistance is an asset. 
 
•  
Fluent in English, Czech & another Eastern language (minimum B2 level).

Do you have kitchen experience and enjoy working with fresh products? Are you hands-on, reliable, and looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow? Then we would love to meet you!
 

Your responsibilities
 

As a Production Kitchen Worker, you will be part of a motivated team responsible for preparing and processing fresh vegetables on a daily basis.
 

Your tasks include:
 

 
• Cleaning and washing vegetables.
 
• Cutting and preparing vegetables both manually and with machines.
 
• Operating vegetable cutting equipment safely and efficiently.
 
• Maintaining a clean and hygienic work environment.
 
• Following quality and food safety standards.

• You are comfortable with physical work and enjoy staying active.

• You are available to work on Mondays and Saturdays.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.
You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with Angular & front-end development in general
• Experience in Java-environments
•  10 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a CNC Turner/Programmer? This role places you at the heart of precision manufacturing, where you'll operate and program CNC turning machines using advanced Heidenhain and Siemens control systems. Your expertise will ensure the production of high-quality, custom-made spare parts for various industrial applications.

A typical day involves collaborating with a team of five skilled professionals, programming and operating CNC machines, and ensuring finished products meet rigorous quality standards. You'll also engage in measuring and inspecting workpieces and occasionally assist in hydraulic cylinder repairs. A clean, organized workspace is a must to maintain safety and efficiency.

If you're passionate about precision and innovation, apply today to join a team that values expertise and teamwork!

• Proven experience as a CNC Turner/Programmer

• Proficiency in Heidenhain and Siemens control systems

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

• Experience in custom machining and measuring techniques

• Good level of English

• Willingness to work in a day shift, starting at 07:00 or 08:00

Checking the load, transport documentation, and ensuring everything is delivered correctly.

A precise, safety-focused way of working. 

 
•  
Proficiency in Dutch or English (French is a plus)

A friendly, professional communication style and appearance. 

 
•

Step into an exciting role as a Folding Machine Operator - this is your chance to work with a team committed to crafting the future of the printing industry, leveraging cutting-edge technology and a no-nonsense approach.Your day will involve setting up and operating folding machines like the Heidelberg Stahlfolder, ensuring that all materials meet quality standards. You’ll perform regular maintenance and minor repairs, keeping your workspace organized and efficient. Collaboration is key, so you’ll hand over tasks smoothly to your colleagues to maintain seamless production.Ready to make your mark in a future-focused company? Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with ample opportunities for growth and development.

• Strong technical insight, preferably with a technical degree

• Ability to work independently and with precision

• Hands-on attitude, ready to assist wherever needed

• Flexibility to switch machines or work overtime when necessary

• At least 5 years of experience as a folding operator in a printing company

• Experience with perfect binding is a plus

• Proficient in English

Responsibilities:

At this position, your tasks will be highly varied. One day you might be performing (preventive) maintenance on industrial compressors, while the next you could be conducting complex repairs on a generator. In short, you'll have plenty of technical challenges and day-to-day variety.

• Conduct maintenance and repairs on rental equipment such as diesel generators and compressors to ensure optimal performance and safety

• Perform scheduled inspections and preventive maintenance routines to guarantee fleet reliability

• Troubleshoot technical issues, including mechanical and electrical problems, on site or in the workshop

• Prepare equipment efficiently after use to ensure readiness for the next customer

• Document maintenance activities and communicate technical findings clearly to team members and clients

• At least 2/3 years as a workshop technician/ engineer
• Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or a related technical field
• Strong knowledge of diesel engines, compressors, and electrical systems, including reading electrical diagrams 
• Fluency in English, with excellent communication skills for technical discussions and documentation
• Proven problem solving skills, results oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently or in a team
• Flexibility regarding working hours and a proactive attitude toward continuous learning and development

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Senior professional experience with .NET

EDR Antwerp Shipyard is the largest shipyard in Belgium, specialised in ship maintenance and repairs, hull treatment and marine construction. Challenging activities require skilful and motivated team members. Over 150 vessels annually are repaired and maintained at our shipyard in Antwerp, and projects are performed on board vessels across the world.
 

As a 
Crane Operator, you play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient and well organised lifting operations within and around our dry dock. You will primarily operate one of our 
five cranes and support a wide range of dockside activities that contribute directly to vessel repair and maintenance projects. You will join a close knit team of experienced crane operators where teamwork and safety are central.
 

RESPONSIBILITIES
 

• Operate one of the 
five cranes on site, including a Wolff tower crane, a Wolff luffing jib crane and three fully restored shipyard cranes with lifting capacities of up to 100 tonnes
 

• Carry out lifting operations safely and efficiently in accordance with site procedures and operational requirements
 

• Support signalling and guidance of lifting movements in areas with limited visibility or restricted access
 

• Assist with dry dock operations (such as the positioning of docking blocks)
 

• Actively support crane operations by maintaining clear lifting zones, monitoring traffic routes and minimising downtime
 

• Coordinate incoming materials and deliveries, ensuring safe and appropriate storage locations are assigned
 

• Serve as a communication link between subcontractors, shipyard teams, vessel crews and fellow crane operators
 

• Provide basic rigging support and assist colleagues in selecting and using suitable lifting equipment
 

• Maintain good order, cleanliness and safety standards around the dry dock area
 

• Identify, report and document damage, deviations and unsafe situations
 

• Support other operational activities on site when crane work is temporarily unavailable

• Good knowledge of English, which is the primary language used for operational communication, radio contact and coordination with subcontractors and vessel crews
 

• Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage for internal coordination and site instructions. Knowledge of Polish and/or Romanian is considered a strong asset
 

• Strong safety awareness and the ability to maintain oversight and prioritise effectively in a dynamic work environment
 

• Confident communicator with a practical and collaborative approach
 

• Hands on attitude and a consistent commitment to agreed procedures and safety standards
 

• Experience with crane operations, forklifts and/or mobile elevated work platforms is highly advantageous
 

• Flexibility to align working hours (daytime hours) with operational requirements, deliveries and lifting schedules
 

• Weekend work may occur, but is not mandatory and will be arranged in consultation with the other colleagues

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

 

Description

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.
 

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

About Our Client - Katoen Natie
We're proud to partner with Katoen Natie, a global logistics leader with over 170 years of experience operating from the strategic Gent Port. This innovative, international company specializes in warehousing, transport, and supply chain solutions, combining traditional family values with cutting-edge technology and a no-nonsense corporate culture.

At Katoen Natie, colleagues who take initiative and show dedication can grow quickly within their expanding international network.

Jobomschrijving

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 
• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners
Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing
Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling
Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems
Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness
Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment
Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts
Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn
Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!
Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you
Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations
Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift
Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)
Basic Dutch or English communication skills
What Makes You Stand Out:
Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment
Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)
Previous experience in international logistics or port operations
Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace
Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

Are you looking for a job as a Payroll & Benefits Officer in Tienen? Combine payroll, benefits administration, HR support, and process improvement within an international organization. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, you play a key role within the HR team. You ensure employees receive accurate payroll processing and professional support regarding their benefits package. At the same time, you actively contribute to improving HR processes and systems.
 

This is a varied position where you combine administrative accuracy with employee interaction and collaboration with international colleagues.
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Managing payroll processing for employees in Belgium and gradually supporting payroll activities in other European countries.
 
• Administering a range of employee benefits, including company cars, insurance plans, pension schemes, and mobility solutions.
 
• Contributing to the optimization of payroll and HR processes and proactively identifying improvement opportunities.
 
• Ensuring the accurate registration and maintenance of employee data and HR records.
 
• Acting as the main point of contact for employees and managers regarding payroll and benefits-related questions. 
 

In addition, you work closely with payroll providers, insurance partners, and internal stakeholders. You also support reporting activities related to absenteeism, employee turnover, and other HR metrics.

 

For this Payroll & Benefits Officer position, we are looking for someone who enjoys working with figures, processes, and people. You are accurate, communicative, and thrive in an international environment.
 

You bring:
 

 
• A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent experience.
 
• Experience in payroll, HR administration, or a similar role.
 
• An excellent command of English. Knowledge of Dutch, French, or other European languages is a strong asset.
 
• Solid MS Office skills. Experience with Workday and/or SD Worx is considered a plus.
 
• A proactive, customer-oriented, and communicative personality. 
 

In addition, you have a strong analytical mindset, enjoy working with data, and pay close attention to detail. This enables you to maintain an overview, meet deadlines, and handle confidential information with the utmost discretion.
